This juice is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in tall grasslands, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

Olvatári juice is spread over burns to encourage healing. It restores 1–10 concussion hits lost to heat and greatly reduces scarring. Properly preserved, the liquid remains potent for two years, an unusually long period for a prepared herbal remedy.
